Its sturdy metal construction makes it quite durable, but its weight requires decent skill to wield.|Inventory|TotK}} Knight's Shields go unnamed in {{AoC}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 40 |durability = 23 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Knight's Shield}} Knight's Shields are mid-tier [[Shield]]s once favored by the [[Knight of Hyrule|Knights of Hyrule]] who guarded the [[Royal Family of Hyrule]]. They belong to the [[Knight's Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of [[Weapon]]s manufactured for Knights.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 168}} They boast a great defense and [[Durability]], comparable to that of even the strongest [[Enemy]] Shields. Though their metal construction makes them Durable, their weight makes it so they require more skill to wield. They can be found around the northern half of [[Hyrule Kingdom]], wielded by Enemies in the [[Hebra Mountains]] and [[Eldin Mountains]]. There are a few notable exceptions, however, including a Treasure Chest in [[Gerudo Canyon Pass]]. Another Treasure Chest is located near [[Aquame Bridge]] leading to the [[Coliseum Ruins]]. It can be obtained as a reward from [[Selmie]] for completing the [[Shield-Surfing (Mini-Game)|Shield-Surfing]] [[Mini-Game]] with a time between 1:45 and 2:00.{{Cite|A shiny new record deserves a shiny new shield. Here y'go!|Selmie|BotW}} Finally, [[Russ]] sells a Knight's Shield on [[Trilby Plain]] for 300 [[Rupee]]s.{{Cite|The {{Color BotW|Blue|knight's shield}}? A study choice, sure. Perfect for shredding, my man! How's about {{Color BotW|Red|300 rupees}}?|Russ|BotW}} If [[Link]] buys it from him, he will call it a sturdy Shield, which reminds him of the rumored Durability of the [[Hylian Shield]].{{Cite|Rock solid, man! That shield right there won't easily break, that's for sure. Oh! Speaking of not breaking, have ya heard about the {{Color BotW|Blue|Hylian shield}}? Everyone in the surfing scene covets that bad boy. It's clearly comissioned by the royal family or something'! Its sturdiness makes it perfect for shield surfing too! You don't really see 'em around these days...but rumor has it there's one in {{Color BotW|Blue|Hyrule Castle}}. {{Small|{{Color BotW|Gray|Though no one has ever gone there and returned in one piece...}}}}|Russ|BotW}} The following [[amiibo]] have a chance to spawn a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Knight's Shield when they are scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]: * {{SSB}} Series [[Link]] amiibo * {{TLoZ Series}} Series [[Link]] ({{TLoZ}}) amiibo * {{TLoZ|-}} Series [[Toon Zelda]] ({{TWW}}) amiibo * {{TLoZ|-}} Series [[Link]] ({{TP}}) amiibo * {{TLoZ|-}} Series [[Link]] ({{SS}}) amiibo * {{BotW}} Series [[Princess Zelda|Zelda]] amiibo Being made of metal, Knight's Shields conduct [[Electricity]] and will attract [[Lightning]] if equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]]. In addition, they sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and will not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. Finally, Knight's Shields can be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]] on the Sheikah Slate. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_003" |Life = 23 |GuardPower = 40 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 3 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 8 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 4 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 5 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 9 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 14 |RideBreakRatio = 1.0 |MirrorLevel = 0 |SurfingFriction = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 40 |durability = 23 |flammable = No |magnetic = |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Knight's Shield}} {{Stub|TotK}} Knight's Shields reappear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Apeparances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Knight's Shields can be wielded by Link in conjunction with [[Knight's Broadsword]]s. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Knight's Gear * Royal Guard's Shield * Royal Shield * Shield }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Knight's Gear, Shields |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
